import numpy as np
# Find DTG peak in 450-800 C range
dtg = np.gradient(y1, x)
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
if mask.any():
    idx_local = np.argmin(dtg[mask]) # min derivative is max mass loss rate
    indices = np.where(mask)[0]
    i_peak = indices[idx_local]
    
    # Tangent slope at peak
    slope = dtg[i_peak]
    x_tan = x[i_peak]
    y_tan = y1[i_peak]
    
    # Baseline: horizontal line at weight at 500 C
    y_base = np.interp(500, x, y1)
    
    # Extrapolated onset temperature:
    # Intersection of tangent line and baseline
    # y_base = slope * (T_onset - x_tan) + y_tan
    # T_onset = x_tan + (y_base - y_tan) / slope
    if slope != 0:
        t_onset = x_tan + (y_base - y_tan) / slope
        marks.append({"type": "vline", "x": float(t_onset), "text": f"Onset {t_onset:.1f} °C"})
    else:
        marks.append({"type": "text", "x": 500, "y": 50, "text": "Slope zero"})
